description: Consumi trasporto pubblico locale Genova (GE) is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Genova. Consumi annuali di combustibile dei veicoli adibiti a trasporto pubblico circolanti nel Comune di Genova, espressi in MWh, con indicazione delle relative emissioni di CO2. I valori sono riportati in forma aggregata, in funzione dell'anno, del tipo di veicolo e della tipologia di combustibile (benzina, gas liquido/GPL, metano, gasolio/diesel, biofuel, energia elettrica). Coverage: Comune di Genova. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Genova. Its tags are co2, consumi, consumi-carburanti, consumi-energia-genova, consumi-energia-genova-trasporti. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-02-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
